name: optimistic-lock-lab
description: Lab bài 02/02: Optimistic Offline Lock (cột version) chống lost update trên PostgreSQL 16

scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d logistics -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v shipments=${SHIPMENTS:-10000} < db/seed-shipments.sql
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d logistics -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/add-version-column.sql
scripts.db:stats-reset: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d logistics -c 'SELECT pg_stat_statements_reset()'
scripts.db:stats: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d logistics -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/save-statement-stats.sql
